tools.name: get_revit_context
tools.title: Revit context
tools.description: Start here. Revit version, open models (active one first), and for the active model: active view, selection, levels, project info, worksharing and length units. All tools use millimetres, m2, m3 and degrees; element ids are integers.

tools.name: reload_addin
tools.title: Reload the add-in
tools.description: Load T3LabRevit.Core.dll again (after an update). The connection drops for a second; call get_revit_context after.

tools.name: t3lab_narrate
tools.title: Show goal and steps
tools.description: Tell the user what you are doing in Revit: your goal and task list appear on the T3Lab Agent Cursors bar and the current task is ticked off as you go. Call it at the start of multi-step work (goal + tasks), with step=N when you move to task N, and done=true at the end. Changes nothing in the model.

goal.description: What you are doing, one short line

step.description: The task you are on now, 1-based

tools.name: manage_document
tools.title: Open, save, switch or close a model
tools.description: Model files. action=open (path; detach=true detaches a central model, audit=true audits), activate (title or path of an open model: makes it the active one), save (active or title), save_as (path, overwrite), close (title of a model that is NOT active; save=true saves first), sync (synchronize with central: comment, relinquish=true), new (save_as path, optional template path; the new model becomes active).

path.description: File path of the .rvt for open / save_as / new

title.description: Title of an open model (from get_revit_context) for activate / save / close

template.description: Template .rte for new (default: the project template set in Revit)

audit.description: open: audit the model while opening

relinquish.description: sync: relinquish all borrowed elements and worksets (default true)

annotations.title: Open, save, switch or close a model

tools.name: list_views
tools.title: List views
tools.description: Views of the active model (no sheets: use list_sheets). Filter by type (FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, EngineeringPlan, AreaPlan, Section, Elevation, ThreeD, Drafting, Legend, Schedule, DraftingView), name, level or placement on a sheet.

placed.description: true = only views on a sheet, false = only views on no sheet

tools.name: set_active_view
tools.title: Open a view
tools.description: Make a view (or sheet) the active view in Revit, by name or id.

view.description: View or sheet name, or id

tools.name: create_view
tools.title: Create a view
tools.description: Create a view: kind=floor_plan, ceiling_plan, structural_plan (level), 3d (isometric), drafting, or duplicate (view + mode plain | detailing | dependent). Optional name, scale and view template.

level.description: Level name or id for plans (default: active view level)

tools.name: get_selection
tools.title: Get selection
tools.description: Elements the user has selected in Revit (ids + summary).

tools.name: set_selection
tools.title: Select / zoom elements
tools.description: Select elements in Revit so the user sees them; zoom=true also zooms the active view to them. Empty list clears the selection.

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

tools.name: view_graphics
tools.title: Color, hide or isolate in a view
tools.description: Change how elements look in a view (active by default): action=color (rgb [r,g,b], transparency 0-100, solid fill), reset (remove overrides), hide, unhide, isolate (temporary isolate), clear_temporary (end temporary hide/isolate).

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

annotations.title: Color, hide or isolate in a view

tools.name: export_image
tools.title: Look at a view (image)
tools.description: Render a view (default: the active one) to a PNG and return it so you can see the model. pixels = width (default 1400, max 2400). save_path also keeps the file.

view.description: View or sheet name or id (default active)

tools.name: query_elements
tools.title: Find elements
tools.description: Find model elements in the active model. Filters combine: categories (Walls, Doors, OST_StructuralColumns...), class (Wall, Floor, FamilyInstance...), in_view (only what the active view shows), selection (only the selected elements), level, type_contains (family or type name), name_contains, where [{parameter, op: eq|ne|contains|gt|lt|gte|lte|empty|not_empty, value}]. detail=count (default on an unfiltered query) | summary | full (location + bounding box). fields = parameter values to add per element. group_by=category|family|type|level returns counts. Numbers are mm, m2, m3, degrees.

class.description: Revit API class, e.g. Wall, Floor, FamilyInstance, Grid

in_view.description: Only elements visible in the active view

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (name or id)

type_contains.description: Part of the family or type name

fields.description: Parameter names to return per element

types.description: Query element types instead of instances

tools.name: get_element_info
tools.title: Element details
tools.description: Everything about up to 50 elements: category, family, type, level, location, bounding box, host, workset, phase, group, and all parameters (instance; type ones too with include_type=true). Use parameter names from here in set_parameter.

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

tools.name: list_types
tools.title: List family types
tools.description: Element types (wall types, floor types, family symbols, title blocks, text types...) by category or class, with their ids; use the 'Family: Type' label in create tools. count=true adds how many instances use each type.

category.description: Category, e.g. Walls, Doors, Title Blocks

class.description: Type class, e.g. WallType, FloorType, FamilySymbol, TextNoteType, ViewFamilyType

name_contains.description: Part of the family or type name

tools.name: list_datums
tools.title: Levels and grids
tools.description: All levels (name, elevation mm) and grids (name, start/end mm) of the active model.

tools.name: set_parameter
tools.title: Set parameter values
tools.description: Set parameters on elements, one Undo step for the whole call. Either element_ids + values {name: value} (same values on every element), or changes [{element_id, parameter, value}] (a value per element). target=type writes the type parameter instead (every instance of that type changes). Numbers are mm, m2, m3, degrees; text on a number parameter is parsed by Revit ("1200", "1.2 m"); yes/no as true/false; an id parameter takes an id or a level / material / type name. Built-in names like ALL_MODEL_MARK work too. Elements that fail are listed; the others are still set.

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

values.description: Parameter name -> value, applied to every element in element_ids

tools.name: create_walls
tools.title: Create walls
tools.description: Create walls from lines. walls=[{start, end, type?, level?, height?, base_offset?, structural?, flip?}] (mm), or points=[[x,y],...] for a chain (closed=true joins the last point to the first) with shared type / level / height. Defaults: first wall type, the active view's level, height 3000 mm.

walls.description: Walls: start, end [x,y] mm; optional type, level, height, base_offset, structural, flip

tools.name: create_floor
tools.title: Create a floor or ceiling
tools.description: Create a floor (kind=floor, default) or ceiling (kind=ceiling) from a closed boundary of points [[x,y],...] mm on a level, with an optional type and height offset (mm). room_id uses that room's boundary instead.

points.description: Boundary points [x, y] mm, in order (closed automatically)

room_id.description: Use the outer boundary of this room

type.description: Floor / ceiling type label or name

offset.description: Height offset from the level in mm

tools.name: create_levels
tools.title: Create levels
tools.description: Create levels: levels=[{name, elevation}] (elevation mm). plan=true (default) also makes a floor plan for each.

plan.description: Create a floor plan per level (default true)

tools.name: create_grids
tools.title: Create grids
tools.description: Create straight grids: grids=[{name?, start, end}] (mm). Names are kept when free.

tools.name: place_family_instance
tools.title: Place family instances
tools.description: Place instances of a family type at points (mm): furniture, equipment, columns, doors and windows. type = 'Family: Type' label (list_types). Doors / windows need a host wall: host_id, or the nearest wall is found. rotation in degrees. Structural columns are placed level to the level above unless height is given.

type.description: Family type label (Family: Type), type name, or id

category.description: Category to search the type in (optional)

points.description: Insertion points [x, y] or [x, y, z] mm

level.description: Level name or id (default: active view level)

tools.name: create_rooms
tools.title: Create rooms
tools.description: Place rooms on a level: points=[[x,y],...] mm (one room per point, inside enclosed boundaries) with optional names / numbers, or all=true to fill every enclosed region on the level that has no room yet.

level.description: Level name or id (default: active view level)

all.description: Create rooms in all closed regions of the level

tools.name: load_family
tools.title: Load a family
tools.description: Load an .rfa family file into the model (overwrite=true replaces an existing one and its parameter values).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing family of that name

tools.name: transform_elements
tools.title: Move, copy, rotate or mirror
tools.description: operation=move (vector [dx,dy,dz] mm), copy (vector; copies=N makes N copies spaced by vector), rotate (angle degrees about a vertical axis through center [x,y] mm, default the elements' centre), mirror (axis_start / axis_end [x,y] mm; copy=true keeps the originals). One Undo step; new ids are returned for copy / mirror copies.

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

vector.description: Offset [dx, dy] or [dx, dy, dz] mm

tools.name: delete_elements
tools.title: Delete elements
tools.description: Delete elements (and what depends on them: tags, hosted doors...). dry_run=true only reports what would be deleted. One Undo step.

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

tools.name: create_annotation
tools.title: Add text, lines, tags or dimensions
tools.description: 2D annotation in a view (default active). kind=text: items [{point, text}] (+ text_type); kind=detail_line: items [{start, end}] (+ line_style); kind=tag: element_ids, tags each element at its centre (leader=true adds a leader); kind=dimension: items [{start, end, element_ids?}] dimensions the elements' faces crossed by the line (walls, grids) or, without element_ids, grids crossed by it. Points in mm.

items.description: text: {point, text}; detail_line: {start, end}; dimension: {start, end, element_ids?}

element_ids.description: Element ids (from query_elements, get_selection or a create tool)

line_style.description: Line style name, e.g. Thin Lines

annotations.title: Add text, lines, tags or dimensions

tools.name: list_sheets
tools.title: List sheets
tools.description: Sheets of the active model: number, name, title block, the views and schedules placed on each, current revision.

tools.name: create_sheets
tools.title: Create sheets
tools.description: Create sheets: sheets=[{number, name}] with a title block ('Family: Type' label, default the first one loaded).

title_block.description: Title block type label or name

tools.name: place_views_on_sheet
tools.title: Place views on a sheet
tools.description: Place views (plans, sections, 3D, drafting, legends) and schedules on a sheet: views=[{view, point?}] with view name or id and the centre point on the sheet in mm (default: the sheet centre, then shifted). A view already on another sheet is reported.

tools.name: get_schedule_data
tools.title: Read a schedule
tools.description: Rows of a schedule as Revit shows them (the first row is usually the headers). Without schedule: lists the schedules. csv_path also writes a UTF-8 CSV that Excel opens (delimiter ; for Excel with a decimal comma).

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.title: Create a schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule of a category with fields by name (as in Revit's Fields dialog, e.g. Family and Type, Level, Mark, Area, Volume, Count). Unknown fields are listed with the available ones.

tools.name: export_documents
tools.title: Export PDF, DWG or IFC
tools.description: Export to a folder. format=pdf (sheets / views; combine=true makes one PDF), dwg (one file per sheet / view), ifc (the whole model). sheets = sheet numbers or ['*'] for all; views = view names or ids. file_name without extension.

sheets.description: Sheet numbers, or * for every sheet

file_name.description: File name (pdf combined / ifc / dwg prefix)

combine.description: pdf: one file for everything (default true)

tools.name: model_overview
tools.title: Model health overview
tools.description: One-call audit of the active model: element counts per category (top 40), warnings (count + top kinds), families, in-place families, views / sheets / views not on sheets, rooms (unplaced / not enclosed), links, imported CAD, worksets, file size.

tools.name: get_warnings
tools.title: Revit warnings
tools.description: The model's warnings grouped by message, with counts and the element ids involved (first ids per group).
